nodes.name: Agent Self-Verification.md
nodes.summary: Wiki knowledge article defining the agent self-verification pattern, covering signal, memory, and execution verification protocols used by autonomous agents to detect and recover from erroneous states.

nodes.name: Multi-Agent Orchestration.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive wiki article describing multi-agent orchestration patterns including Supervisor-Worker (Syndicate Squad), Sequential Routines, and Delegated Subagents, with coordination mechanisms, failure modes, and tradeoff analysis.

nodes.name: Stateless Agent Recovery.md
nodes.summary: Wiki knowledge article defining the stateless agent recovery protocol, describing how agents reconstruct context from scratch after failure using a priority-ordered set of recovery files.

nodes.name: Supervisor Decision Engine.md
nodes.summary: Wiki knowledge article detailing the Supervisor Decision Engine algorithm, including the multi-round scoring function, early-exit logic, treasury mechanics, and its role in routing tasks to the optimal worker agent in the Syndicate Squad.
